entities.name: COc1cccc(Oc2ccccc2[N+](=O)[O-])c1
observations: Atom-tokenized main substrate decodes to a nitro-substituted diaryl ether bearing an aryl methyl ether.
The methoxy group is the site of the matched O-demethylation transformation.

entities.name: Pyridine
observations: The heteroaromatic component decodes to pyridine, c1ccncc1.
Pyridine is treated as an auxiliary or base in the matched reaction record.

entities.name: O=[N+]([O-])c1ccccc1Oc1cccc(O)c1
observations: Matched product from ORD reaction ord-e51ceb31d4cb4cc9ac600a3e7180eecd.
Product retains the diaryl-ether linkage and nitro group while replacing aryl O-methyl with phenolic OH.

entities.name: ord-e51ceb31d4cb4cc9ac600a3e7180eecd
observations: Exact ORD reaction match: COc1cccc(Oc2ccccc2[N+](=O)[O-])c1 with HCl, water, and pyridine gives O=[N+]([O-])c1ccccc1Oc1cccc(O)c1.
The reaction is consistent with regioselective O-demethylation of an aryl methyl ether; chlorine is not incorporated into the substrate.

entities.name: HCl water pyridine
observations: Matched reaction components include HCl, water, and pyridine.
HCl is represented by the chlorine input as hydrochloric acid; water is a component or quench, and pyridine is an auxiliary/base.
